```{r cars,fig.width=12,fig.height=5}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================
# 1. Read ARG, MRG, ABG data
# ==============================
# ---- ARG ----
abund_ARG <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig4_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_ARG_abundance") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(abund_ARG) <- abund_ARG[[1]]
abund_ARG <- abund_ARG[, -1]
abund_ARG[] <- lapply(abund_ARG, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
abund_ARG[is.na(abund_ARG)] <- 0
abund_ARG[abund_ARG < 0] <- 0

# ---- MRG ----
abund_MRG <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig4_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_MRG_abundance") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(abund_MRG) <- abund_MRG[[1]]
abund_MRG <- abund_MRG[, -1]
abund_MRG[] <- lapply(abund_MRG, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
abund_MRG[is.na(abund_MRG)] <- 0
abund_MRG[abund_MRG < 0] <- 0

# ---- ABG ----
abund_ABG <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig4_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_ABG_abundance") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(abund_ABG) <- abund_ABG[[1]]
abund_ABG <- abund_ABG[, -1]
abund_ABG[] <- lapply(abund_ABG, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
abund_ABG[is.na(abund_ABG)] <- 0
abund_ABG[abund_ABG < 0] <- 0

# ---- group ----
group <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_fig4_data.xlsx", sheet = "C_group") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(group) <- group[[1]]
group <- group[, -1]
group$treatment2 <- factor(group$treatment2,
                           levels = c("N0-C0", "N50-C0",
                                      "N0-C2000", "N50-C2000"))

# ==============================
# 2. Sample matching
# ==============================
common_samples <- Reduce(intersect,
                         list(rownames(abund_ARG),
                              rownames(abund_MRG),
                              rownames(abund_ABG),
                              rownames(group)))
abund_ARG <- abund_ARG[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
abund_MRG <- abund_MRG[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
abund_ABG <- abund_ABG[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
group     <- group[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Number of matched samples: ", length(common_samples), "\n")
print(table(group$treatment2))

# ==============================
# 3. Distance matrices (Hellinger + Bray-Curtis)
# ==============================
abund_ARG <- abund_ARG[, colSums(abund_ARG) > 0, drop = FALSE]
abund_MRG <- abund_MRG[, colSums(abund_MRG) > 0, drop = FALSE]
abund_ABG <- abund_ABG[, colSums(abund_ABG) > 0, drop = FALSE]

dist_ARG <- vegdist(decostand(abund_ARG, method = "hellinger"), method = "bray")
dist_MRG <- vegdist(decostand(abund_MRG, method = "hellinger"), method = "bray")
dist_ABG <- vegdist(decostand(abund_ABG, method = "hellinger"), method = "bray")

# ==============================
# 4. Simple Mantel (for reference)
# ==============================
set.seed(315)
mant_ARG_MRG <- mantel(dist_ARG, dist_MRG, permutations = 9999)
set.seed(315)
mant_ARG_ABG <- mantel(dist_ARG, dist_ABG, permutations = 9999)

cat(sprintf("Mantel ARG-MRG: R = %.3f, P = %.4g\n",
            mant_ARG_MRG$statistic, mant_ARG_MRG$signif))
cat(sprintf("Mantel ARG-ABG: R = %.3f, P = %.4g\n",
            mant_ARG_ABG$statistic, mant_ARG_ABG$signif))

# ==============================
# 5. Partial Mantel
# ==============================
set.seed(315)
pm_ARG_MRG_ABG <- mantel.partial(dist_ARG, dist_MRG, dist_ABG,
                                 permutations = 9999)
set.seed(315)
pm_ARG_ABG_MRG <- mantel.partial(dist_ARG, dist_ABG, dist_MRG,
                                 permutations = 9999)

cat("\n===== Partial Mantel =====\n")
cat(sprintf("ARG-MRG | ABG: R = %.3f, P = %.4g\n",
            pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$statistic, pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$signif))
cat(sprintf("ARG-ABG | MRG: R = %.3f, P = %.4g\n",
            pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$statistic, pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$signif))

# ==============================
# 6. Residual calculation (only for scatter plot coordinates)
# ==============================
vec_ARG <- as.vector(dist_ARG)
vec_MRG <- as.vector(dist_MRG)
vec_ABG <- as.vector(dist_ABG)

# Residuals of ARG and MRG after controlling for ABG
res_ARG_ABG <- resid(lm(vec_ARG ~ vec_ABG))
res_MRG_ABG <- resid(lm(vec_MRG ~ vec_ABG))

# Residuals of ARG and ABG after controlling for MRG
res_ARG_MRG <- resid(lm(vec_ARG ~ vec_MRG))
res_ABG_MRG <- resid(lm(vec_ABG ~ vec_MRG))

# ==============================
# 7. Build plotting data
# ==============================
df1 <- data.frame(res_x = res_ARG_ABG, res_y = res_MRG_ABG)
df2 <- data.frame(res_x = res_ARG_MRG, res_y = res_ABG_MRG)

# ==============================
# 7b. 残差回归统计 (lm: res_y ~ res_x) —— 只保留 R² 与 P
# ==============================
fit1 <- lm(res_y ~ res_x, data = df1)
fit2 <- lm(res_y ~ res_x, data = df2)

summ1 <- summary(fit1)
summ2 <- summary(fit2)

r2_1  <- summ1$r.squared
pval1 <- summ1$coefficients["res_x", "Pr(>|t|)"]

r2_2  <- summ2$r.squared
pval2 <- summ2$coefficients["res_x", "Pr(>|t|)"]

cat("\n===== Residual regression (lm res_y ~ res_x) =====\n")
cat(sprintf("Panel a (ARG-MRG|ABG): R2 = %.3f, P = %.4g\n", r2_1, pval1))
cat(sprintf("Panel b (ARG-ABG|MRG): R2 = %.3f, P = %.4g\n", r2_2, pval2))

# ==============================
# 8. Significance marks
# ==============================
sig_mark <- function(P) {
  ifelse(P < 0.001, "***",
         ifelse(P < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(P < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
}

# ==============================
# 9. Annotation text (Partial Mantel + Residual regression，无 slope)
# ==============================
lab1 <- sprintf(
  "Partial Mantel: R = %.2f, P = %.4g %s\nResidual lm: R\u00B2 = %.2f, P = %.4g %s",
  pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$statistic, pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$signif,
  sig_mark(pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$signif),
  r2_1, pval1, sig_mark(pval1)
)

lab2 <- sprintf(
  "Partial Mantel: R = %.2f, P = %.4g %s\nResidual lm: R\u00B2 = %.2f, P = %.4g %s",
  pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$statistic, pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$signif,
  sig_mark(pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$signif),
  r2_2, pval2, sig_mark(pval2)
)

# ==============================
# 10. Separate plots
# ==============================
x_pos1 <- min(df1$res_x) + 0.05 * diff(range(df1$res_x))
y_pos1 <- max(df1$res_y) - 0.05 * diff(range(df1$res_y))

x_pos2 <- min(df2$res_x) + 0.05 * diff(range(df2$res_x))
y_pos2 <- max(df2$res_y) - 0.05 * diff(range(df2$res_y))

p1 <- ggplot(df1, aes(x = res_x, y = res_y)) +
  geom_point(color = "#000080", alpha = 0.5, size = 3.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x = x_pos1, y = y_pos1,
           label = lab1,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Residuals of ARG distance matrix (controlling ABG)",
       y = "Residuals of MRG distance matrix (controlling ABG)",
       title = "ARG\u2013MRG | ABG") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1)
  )

p2 <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = res_x, y = res_y)) +
  geom_point(color = "#FF7F50", alpha = 0.5, size = 3.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x = x_pos2, y = y_pos2,
           label = lab2,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Residuals of ARG distance matrix (controlling MRG)",
       y = "Residuals of ABG distance matrix (controlling MRG)",
       title = "ARG\u2013ABG | MRG") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1)
  )

# ==============================
# 11. Combine plots (a/b 标签加大)
# ==============================
p_combined <- (p1 + p2) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", colour = "black"))

print(p_combined)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig4ab.pdf", p_combined,
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 600)

# ==============================
# 12. Save statistical results
#     Mantel / Partial Mantel / 残差回归 (只含 R2, P)
# ==============================
stat_tab <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("Mantel ARG-MRG",
               "Mantel ARG-ABG",
               "Partial Mantel ARG-MRG | ABG",
               "Partial Mantel ARG-ABG | MRG",
               "Residual lm ARG-MRG | ABG",
               "Residual lm ARG-ABG | MRG"),
  R        = c(mant_ARG_MRG$statistic,
               mant_ARG_ABG$statistic,
               pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$statistic,
               pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$statistic,
               NA, NA),
  P        = c(mant_ARG_MRG$signif,
               mant_ARG_ABG$signif,
               pm_ARG_MRG_ABG$signif,
               pm_ARG_ABG_MRG$signif,
               pval1, pval2),
  R2       = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, r2_1, r2_2)
)
stat_tab$R  <- round(stat_tab$R, 3)
stat_tab$P  <- signif(stat_tab$P, 3)
stat_tab$R2 <- round(stat_tab$R2, 3)
print(stat_tab)
write.csv(stat_tab,
          "~/Desktop/codes/tables/Ex_Fig4ab_Mantel_PartialMantel_results.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
